assets.prompt: StockWars modular ground sprite, clean SIMPLE 2D cartoon illustration matching the recently viewed simplified cream-stone fountain. Fountain image is style/color reference ONLY: do not draw the fountain. Existing beige square paving is a palette reference ONLY: remove its grain and excessive bevel highlights. RPG elevated top-down town floor, screen horizontal/vertical axes, no isometric diamond, no perspective convergence, no thick platform sidewalls. Warm light beige large paving slabs with narrow muted taupe joints, a restrained warm gray-brown border band and cream outer edging. Broad flat colors, only subtle 2-tone shading, no stone grain, scratches, ornate motifs, flowers or decorative clutter. Real transparent background outside the ground footprint. No text, buildings, vegetation, furniture, fountain, water, cars, lane paint or ground shadow. This is pedestrian stone paving to connect the town fountain plaza to existing walkways, not asphalt. One broad circular plaza ground pad seen as a gentle horizontal ellipse, around width-to-height 1.25:1, fully visible centered on a square transparent canvas with padding. A single clean circular border band surrounds a simple open center paved in large square slabs aligned horizontally and vertically, about 6 slabs across. Leave the central half unobstructed for placing a separate fountain on top. Border is flush with the paving, not raised. Keep paving legible at 200px display size. The connecting path will use this exact beige slab and taupe band design.
